description: Unit test class for the Basket entity in eShopOnWeb application, specifically testing the AddItem method behavior.

classes.name: BasketAddItem
classes.description: A unit test class containing tests for adding items to a shopping basket.

methods.name: AddsBasketItemIfNotPresent
methods.description: Tests adding a new item to the basket when it is not already present.

methods.name: IncrementsQuantityOfItemIfPresent
methods.description: Tests incrementing the quantity of an existing item in the basket.

methods.name: KeepsOriginalUnitPriceIfMoreItemsAdded
methods.description: Ensures the original unit price is preserved when additional items are added with different unit prices.

methods.name: DefaultsToQuantityOfOne
methods.description: Tests that adding an item with no quantity specified defaults the quantity to one.

methods.name: CantAddItemWithNegativeQuantity
methods.description: Ensures that adding an item with a negative quantity throws an exception.

methods.name: CantModifyQuantityToNegativeNumber
methods.description: Ensures that modifying an existing item with a negative quantity throws an exception.
